'''Evan Clemens'''<ref name="dt-10406">[http://www.decktech.net/starwarsccg/deck/10406 Evan's Refridgeration Service 2 1], DeckTech (Evan "fizz247" Clemens, 14 September 2000). Preservation copies: [https://www.stephenskilton.com/decktech_archives/10406/ Stephen Skilton]; [https://stevetotheizz0.github.io/decktech_archives/10406/ GitHub Pages]; [https://web.archive.org/web/20261018121202/https://www.decktech.net/starwarsccg/deck/10406/ Wayback Machine].</ref> (DeckTech handle '''fizz247''') posted a [[Dark]] [[This Deal Is Getting Worse All The Time / Pray I Don't Alter It Any Further|This Deal Is Getting Worse All The Time]] list on DeckTech in September 2000.
